Kath & Kim (Australia)
Da Kath & Kim Code - Extended

A Fan Edit I made of the christmas-esq telemovie that fits in chronologically between season 3 and 4 of the TV series
But it has had the deleted scenes edited into the movie

I am posting this as my first edit and might do the series and other movie

I am seeking someone than may be able to assist with ripping Kath & Kim Kountdown Parts 1-3 from Netflix, as I can't seem to find these anywhere, so please help.
